body.name: a
body.def: Let \((U_{\beta},Z)\) be the centered joint Gaussian limit of the scaled complete-randomization factorial error and standardized imbalance, and put \(\mathscr A_{\beta}=\{Z^{\mathsf T}G_{\infty}(\beta)Z\leq q_{\alpha,\beta}\}\). The first-order exact-mixture oracle-gain coefficient is \(a(\beta)=(1-\eta)[E\{U_{\beta}^{\mathsf T}WU_{\beta}\}-\alpha^{-1}E\{U_{\beta}^{\mathsf T}WU_{\beta}\mathbf 1(\mathscr A_{\beta})\}]\).
